mapper.select: SELECT g.grade_name AS hak_info, book.yy AS yyyy, book.mm AS mm, sc.subject_name AS week_subject, book.book_name AS week_title, book.publisher AS week_publisher, book.book_image_url AS week_bookimg FROM erp_book_suggest book JOIN erp_grade_code g ON book.class_key = g.book_class_key LEFT JOIN erp_subject_code sc ON book.subject_key = sc.subject_key JOIN (SELECT TOP 1 yy, mm FROM erp_book_suggest b JOIN erp_grade_code g ON b.class_key = g.book_class_key WHERE g.grade_key = #{gradeKey} ORDER BY yy DESC, mm DESC) latest ON book.yy = latest.yy AND book.mm = latest.mm WHERE g.grade_key = #{gradeKey} ORDER BY book.week;

select g.grade_name AS hak_info, sc.subject_name AS week_subject, book.book_name AS week_title, book.publisher AS week_publisher, book.book_image_url AS week_bookimg from erp_student s JOIN erp_grade_code g ON s.grade_key = g.grade_key JOIN erp_time_table_assign ta ON s.student_id = ta.student_id JOIN erp_time_table t ON ta.time_table_key = t.time_table_key JOIN erp_book_suggest book ON t.class_key = book.class_key and t.yy = book.yy and t.mm = book.mm LEFT JOIN erp_subject_code sc ON book.subject_key = sc.subject_key WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId} AND t.yy = #{yy} AND t.mm = #{mm} order by t.yy, t.mm, book.week
